title: Unify embedding metric semantics and opt-in normalization for reranking
creator: Elena Wang
description:
Problem: clients currently assume different semantics for similarity scoring (some use raw dot product, some implicitly rely on cosine similarity via pre-normalized vectors). This causes: inconsistencies in reranking quality across clients, surprising changes when we change vector precision/quantization or when we normalize on the server, and hidden bugs when users store legacy embeddings and compare them against newly-normalized runtime embeddings.

Goal: Provide a clear, backward-compatible API surface and server-side implementation that: (1) documents and exposes the distance metric used by each embeddings model/endpoint, (2) adds an opt-in server-side normalization path that guarantees cosine-equivalent scoring without changing default legacy behavior, (3) improves throughput by using a fast L2-normalization kernel on GPU where possible, and (4) provides migration tooling and clear guidance for customers with stored embeddings.

This ticket covers design, implementation, testing, rollout strategy, and docs for the API/runner changes required to support these semantics safely.
acceptance_criteria: API returns a stable 'metric' field in the embeddings response metadata (values: 'dot', 'cosine', 'cosine-normalized').
New query param 'normalize=true' is accepted by embeddings and reranking endpoints and returns values compatible with server-side cosine scoring.
Default behavior for existing clients is unchanged unless they opt into 'normalize' or call new normalized endpoints.
Unit and integration tests validate numerical equivalence: dot(normalize(a), normalize(b)) == cosine(a, b) within 1e-6 for float32 and appropriate tolerance for quantized formats.
Benchmark: normalized path has <=15% throughput overhead compared to dot-only path on p4d.24xlarge for typical 768/1536-dim workloads using batched normalization kernel.
Migration guide and 1-click export tool for converting stored embeddings to normalized form are published in the docs repo with examples.
Rollout plan executed: canary (5%) -> ramp (25%) -> full (100%) with automatic rollback on observed quality regressions or latency SLO violations.
Backward compatibility tests covering legacy clients that store raw vectors are added to the nightly test matrix.
implementation_notes: Add 'metric' string to embeddings response metadata; populate from model profile or endpoint override.
Introduce server-side fast L2 normalization kernel in runtime: implement fused L2-norm + reciprocal using half-precision accumulation for GPU, with deterministic fallback on CPU.
Expose query param 'normalize' (default false). When true, server returns normalized vectors and also uses normalized vectors for reranking pipelines (so dot product equals cosine).
Store a light compatibility header 'x-emb-metric' in cached responses to prevent mixing normalized and unnormalized cached items.
Avoid changing existing model artifacts on disk. Do not re-normalize stored model weights or precomputed embeddings by default.
Add a server-side conversion utility for users: CLI script that reads a ndjson line-per-embedding and emits normalized vectors, with streaming and chunked memory usage to support large datasets.
Database migration plan: do not automatically migrate customer S3/DB objects. Provide migration helper and sample SQL/BigQuery job in docs.
Add perf flag to runtime to enable 'normalize' kernel path and a metric in telemetry to measure adoption and latency impact.
Update SDKs to include a typed parameter for normalize (bool) and to surface the returned 'metric' metadata.
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Spike complete — implemented prototype normalization kernel in a private branch. Observed 1.08x latency for single-request 1536-dims with batching=8 on p3.8xlarge.
2026-03-04: Design doc published: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Embedding+Metric+Semantics+Design (internal). Link contains API surface, telemetry plan, and migration notes.
2026-03-06: Security & infra flagged cache header requirement to prevent mixed cache serving (ENG-7450 dependency opened).
2026-03-09: End-to-end integration tests added to ci/embeddings; initial unit tests for numerical tolerance landed in PR #8345 (github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8345).
2026-03-12: QA validated numeric equivalence for float32; quantized 8-bit modes show expected 0.002 delta for 768-dim vectors (within tolerance).
2026-03-14: Began canary rollout on eu-west-1 with normalize=false default and normalize opt-in enabled via feature flag. Observing baseline latency impact of ~7% on sample traffic.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Customers will unknowingly mix normalized and unnormalized embeddings leading to low-quality reranking. Mitigation: add strict cache headers, telemetry alerts for mixed-reads, and an 'incompatibility' warning in the console when queries mix metrics.

Risk: Normalization kernel increases p99 latency under heavy batching. Mitigation: implement adaptive path that skips per-request normalization for large batches and instead runs an async normalization job when possible; provide autoscale knobs.

Risk: Quantization amplifies numeric drift. Mitigation: tighten acceptance tests for quantized modes and document expected deltas. Offer a 'force-recompute' migration utility for high-precision customers.
Risk: Backwards compatibility regressions. Mitigation: nightly matrix includes legacy client tests and we keep default behavior unchanged unless 'normalize=true' is passed.
testing_plan: Unit tests: normalization math, edge cases (zero vectors), deterministic paths for CPU/GPU.
Integration tests: embeddings->rerank flow with both normalize=true and normalize=false across quantized/unquantized models.
Performance tests: microbenchmarks for kernel on representative instance types (p3, p4, infer-rt specialized HW), end-to-end load tests for common batch sizes.
Canary experiments: measure MRR and NDCG on internal reranking eval set and compare to baseline. Auto-fail deployment if quality drops >1% or latency p95 increases >20%.
Compatibility tests: stored-embedding lookup tests where stored vectors were produced by older server versions.
docs_and_rollout_tasks: Docs: API doc describing 'metric' field and 'normalize' param with examples in curl/py/js.
Migration guide: example scripts for exporting, normalizing, and re-importing embeddings to S3 and BigQuery.
SDK updates: add 'normalize' param and return typed metadata in python/js SDKs; include a 'compat' helper method that wraps dot vs cosine usage.
Console: show metric metadata on per-model card and surface a migration warning when mismatch detected.
Release notes: clearly state default behavior unchanged and provide guidance for switching.
